entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something. Order number is VF789-011. Let's make this quick.
Okay, I'm pulling up that order now, VF789-011. I see a pair of mountain bike shoes purchased 57 days ago. Can I ask what the issue is with the cycling shoes?
They don't work for me. They're causing terrible blisters. I just want a refund. Yes or no, can I return them?
Yes, absolutely. I see here the delivery date was unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. Just one quick question, have the cleats been installed and removed already?
They were, but they're off now. The shoes are in the original box. I just need the return label to get my refund.

Not a problem at all. I have just approved the return. I'm emailing the prepaid shipping label to you right now. You should see it in your inbox in the next minute or two. Also, I see you're one of our VIP members, and I want to apologize for the inconvenience with the shoes. I've added a free expedited shipping voucher to your account for your next purchase.
Okay, the email just came through. That works. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Great. Thanks for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
